title: Law requiring city LGBTQI+ health resources and a provider map
summary: This bill would require the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to post online resources about LGBTQI+ health and gender-affirming care, including information on accessing LGBTQI+-affirming providers, obtaining and providing gender-affirming care and related rights. It would also require the department to maintain a public, searchable online map of LGBTQI+ health services showing each provider's address, hours, contact information, services offered and accepted insurance. The bill would take effect immediately upon passage.
